words.meaning: n. 艾斯卡罗比亚（虚构国名）

examples.en: The Ambassador of Escalopia returned home.
examples.zh: 艾斯卡罗比亚的大使回到了家。

examples.en: His clothes were in a frightful state.
examples.zh: 他的衣服破得一塌糊涂。

examples.en: He was lucky enough to escape.
A fire broke out in the embassy basement.
The fire broke out in the embassy.
The students were demonstrating outside the embassy.
examples.zh: 学生们在大使馆外示威。

examples.en: He will never forget the frightful scenes.
examples.zh: 他永远不会忘记那些可怕的场面。

examples.en: The fire was not very serious.
The Ambassador was interviewed by a reporter.
examples.zh: 大使接受了记者的采访。
他的衣服被烧焦得很厉害。

sentences.en: When the Ambassador of Escalopia returned home for lunch, his wife got a shock.
sentences.zh: 当艾斯卡罗比亚的大使回家吃午饭时，他的妻子大吃一惊。

sentences.en: He looked pale and his clothes were in a frightful state.
sentences.zh: 他脸色苍白，衣服也破烂不堪。

sentences.en: She asked him what had happened, and he explained that a fire had broken out in the embassy basement.
sentences.zh: 她问他发生了什么事，他解释说大使馆地下室起火了。

sentences.en: The fire had been started by some university students who were demonstrating outside the embassy.
sentences.zh: 火是一些在大使馆外示威的大学生点燃的。

sentences.en: The Ambassador was certainly lucky to be alive.
sentences.zh: 大使能活着当然很幸运。

article.en: When the Ambassador of Escalopia returned home for lunch, his wife got a shock.
article.zh: 当艾斯卡罗比亚的大使回家吃午饭时，他的妻子大吃一惊。

article.en: He looked pale and his clothes were in a frightful state.
article.zh: 他脸色苍白，衣服也破烂不堪。

article.en: She asked him what had happened, and he explained that a fire had broken out in the embassy basement.
article.zh: 她问他发生了什么事，他解释说大使馆地下室起火了。

article.en: He said he was lucky enough to escape, but he would never be able to forget the frightful scenes.
article.zh: 他说自己很幸运逃了出来，但他永远也忘不了那些可怕的场面。

article.en: The fire had been started by some university students who were demonstrating outside the embassy.
article.zh: 火是一些在大使馆外示威的大学生点燃的。

article.en: The Ambassador was certainly lucky to be alive.
article.zh: 大使能活着当然很幸运。

article.en: Later that day, he told a reporter that the students had set the embassy on fire.
article.zh: 当天晚些时候，他告诉记者，学生们点燃了大使馆。

article.en: He added that the fire was not very serious and that the students had not done much damage.
article.zh: 他补充说，火势并不严重，学生们没有造成多大破坏。

article.en: The reporter asked him how his clothes had become so badly burnt.
article.zh: 记者问他衣服怎么会烧得这么厉害。

article.en: With a smile, the Ambassador replied, 'Everything will be all right in time, my dear.'
article.zh: 大使微笑着回答：“一切迟早都会好起来的，亲爱的。”
